profile.headline: Team Lead and Senior Rails Developer | Ruby on Rails | Postgresql | VueJS | Leadership | Ownership | Full SDLC
profile.summary:
I am a lead full stack web developer, project manager and team lead with over 15 years of experience in developing and maintaining website code and server infrastructure.

I consider myself a product-oriented developer, with a lot of emphasis on quality and attention to detail, able to see the big picture and make things happen.

I am a self-starter, able to work well both independently and in a team setting, either as team lead or as team member.

Ruby is the language that I like the most, along with the tools it provides us with. For example the blocks and lambdas, method_missing, class_eval, instance_eval, method alias, modules mixins, and all the other means for metaprogramming it features. It is a very powerful and expressive language ideal to get things done. And it provides us with a super useful interactive console, irb. Let me say it again: I love Ruby.

To a lesser extend, I've also worked with PHP. I have a strong foundation in C, and basic knowledge of Perl, Python, Objective-C, and Erlang. I can find my way around virtually any language if needed to complete a task. I wear my SysAdmin hat too, whenever needed.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Role requirements:
* feature development.
* system monitoring and maintenance.
* bug fixes and issue resolution: address and rectify bugs and issues as they arise, utilizing tools like
AppSignal/Datadog for efficient tracking and resolution.
* code reviews: ensure code quality and feature correctness.
* performance improvements: optimize SQL queries to meet performance requirements on highly populated database.
positions.insights: Skills: Ruby · Ruby on Rails · PostgreSQL · Redis · Sidekiq

positions.description:
Consulting and development services for SaaS companies.

* PostgreSQL
* Redis
* Sidekiq

positions.title: Senior Backend Engineer
positions.description:
Role requirements:
* Improving background job queue performance by batching jobs to then perform database read and write operations in bulk.
* Removing N+1s from background jobs on both read and write database operations.
* Improving mobile push notifications delivery performance by a hundred fold.
* Improving email delivery performance by a thousand fold.
positions.insights: Skills: Ruby · Ruby on Rails · PostgreSQL · Redis · Sidekiq

positions.title: Engineering Tech Lead
positions.description:
Role requirements:
* leading and animating transversal engineering projects, while seeking for operational excellence.
* collaborating with the product team to create and implement product vision and roadmap.
* managing multiple engineers.
* driving best practices and quality for the team and the broader engineering organization.
* developing, and retaining top talent of the organization.
* code review and QA PRs.
* contributing improvements to the code base.
positions.insights: Skills: Ruby · PostgreSQL · Ruby on Rails · TypeScript · React.js · Open API · Team Leadership · SQL

positions.title: Team Lead and Full Stack Rails Developer
positions.description:
Below you can find some of the tasks I took care of and some of the tools I used.

Role requirements:
* report to CTO and Lead Architect.
* discuss/refine specification document details (as well as wireframes and mockups) in order to make them clear before proceeding with actual implementation.
* write UAT for each feature worked on in order for the QA team to be able to test such feature.
* work independently.
* follow code and UX best practices as well as company procedures.
* high level of attention to detail.
* investigate and fix customer issues (escalated by the Customer Support team) in a timely manner.
* code review PRs, sometimes QA'ing them too.

As a Team Lead:
* Led a team of 5+ developers, setting tasks' priorities, and leading projects to completion.
* Onboarded new team members to the company's culture and practices.
* Mentored team members, providing help, guidance and feedback.
* Facilitated sprint planning calls, retro calls, 1-on-1 calls, as well as other team calls.
* Provided regular updates to stakeholders.

As Project Lead:
* made sure that the PRs for all the organization members moved smoothly through code review and QA.
* followed up on the progress made on tasks helping solve any questions that arose.
* ensured that the communication flowed properly within the project members, following up to get answers on asynchronous discussions when needed.

Development:
* implemented 110+ pull requests (including implementing the invoicing system from the ground up).
* refactored backend code and views to accommodate feature requirement needs.
* took good care of edge cases.
* reported and fixed bugs.
* wrote automated tests (thousands of them).

Some tools I used:
* ruby 2.2.6, 2.5.5, 2.7.3
* rails 4.2.7.1, 5.2, 6.0
* Heroku
* Github
* html5, css3, slim
* bootstrap
* javascript, jquery
* VueJS
* select2 (see select2.org)
* fullcalendar (see fullcalendar.io)
* postgresql
* sidekiq / redis
* memcached
* git
* rspec, etc
* grape
* Airbrake
* Logentries
positions.insights: Skills: Representational State Transfer (REST) · Ruby · PostgreSQL · Ruby on Rails · SQL · Vue.js · RSpec

positions.title: Full Stack Rails Developer and Devops
positions.description:
Below you can find some of the tasks I took care of and some of the tools I used.

Development:
* integration with Stripe and Taxamo for tax-aware recurring charges
* integration with Zapier
* integration with third party services to retrieve user contacts
* implement pushed updates for real-time collaboration
* implement Continuous Integration and Delivery based on docker containers

System Administration:
* migration to a docker-based AWS setup for both staging and production environments

Some tools I used:
* ruby 2.2.0
* rails 4.2.3
* faye-rails
* AWS: s3, ec2, elb, autoscaling groups, ecs, ecr, rds postgres, lambda, iam
* gitlab CI runners
* factory_girl, minitest, capybara
* docker
* nginx
* git
* capistrano
* linux
* coffescript, haml, jquery
* stripejs, taxamo
* postgresql
positions.insights: Skills: Representational State Transfer (REST) · PostgreSQL · Ruby on Rails · JavaScript · Docker · SQL

positions.title: Senior Rails Developer
positions.description:
Below you can find some of the tasks I took care of and some of the tools I used.

Development:
• external data sources integration via REST and SOAP webservices
• REST webservices development to be used by third parties
• integration with third-party SMS delivery services and email delivery services
• Mechanize/Nokogiri
• integration with Paypal to emit automated payments, ActiveMerchant.
• development and improvement of complex SQL queries to work in the context of highly populated databases
• database triggers and embedded procedures
• maintenance and development of the business logic of the code key to the business model
• writting automated tests for models and controllers
• development of maintenace scripts to be executed on regular basis, both rake tasks in the context of a rails project and in "standalone" ruby scripts, depending on the task requirements
• debugging difficult-to-spot errors and providing the right solution, including monkey patching gems/libraries when required

System Administration:
• server infrastructure setup and maintenance (10+ servers)
• load balancing setup and configuratioin management for production applications with nginx and/or apache
• load balancing management between the several servers, required to ensure the service availability
• monitoring solution development to watch the memory usage of critical application Unix processes

Some tools I used:
* ruby 1.8.7, 1.9.3
* rails 2.3.18, rails 3.0
* mysql, memcached
* apache, nginx, haproxy
* mechanize, handsoap, nokogiri, activemerchant, restclient
* rspec, shoulda, factory_girl, capybara
* git, subversion
* capistrano
* html, css
* ubuntu linux
* mac os x
* bash, grep, awk, sed, vi, wc
* python
positions.insights: Skills: Representational State Transfer (REST) · Ruby · MySQL · Ruby on Rails · JavaScript · SQL

positions.title: PHP developer
positions.description:
Development:
* sitemaps to feed google crawler
* views for the digital newspaper's archive of posts
* implemented view/controller integration for html provided by the designer
* functional testing of the whole website in the integration environment

Tools:
* php5
* Zend Framework
* mysql, sqlite3
* linux, vmware
positions.insights: Skills: MySQL · Zend Framework · PHP · SQLite · SQL

positions.title: Ruby on Rails developer and System Administrator
positions.description:
Below you can find some of the tasks I took care of and some of the tools I used.

Development:
• external data sources integration via REST and SOAP webservices
• development of controllers, routes definitions, before filters, mailers, custom plugins
• development of models, migrations, activeRecord associations, named_scope, custom validators, callbacks
• debugging difficult-to-spot errors and providing the right solution, including monkey patching gems/libraries when required
• upgrading application to the next rails version
• capistrano recipes development and maintenace
• javascript/jquery, html, css

System Administration:
• server infrastructure setup and maintenance (8+ servers)
• installation and maintenance of firewall for production web servers
• load balancing setup and configuratioin management for production applications with nginx and/or apache
• load balancing management between the several servers, required to ensure the service availability
• shared file system setup with NFS, Rsync y cron
• monitoring solution development to watch the memory usage of critical application Unix processes
• MySql configuration for database replication in master-slave mode; database creation and access restrictions configuration

Some tools I used:
* ruby 1.8.7
* rails 1.2.3 to 2.3.5
* subversion
* mysql
* apache, nginx
* capistrano
* nfs, rsync
* javascript, jquery, prototype, ajax
* html, css
* trac, redmine
* linux (redhat, fedora, ubuntu)
* bash, grep, awk, sed, vi, wc
* perl
